text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho,
Soi soi soi soi♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look who it is, Trainer.
Keep up that healthy gill-breathing today, alright?

For some reason,
Gold Ship was walking around in her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, truth is, I was engaged in a brutal battle
known as tuna fishing just a bit ago.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To win, I needed
the power of a red protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's with you?
Don't you know the ultimate power that red holds?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Think back to your childhood days.
Super Sentai heroes, hot-blooded manga protagonists—
they were almost always red, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoever wears red is the coolest and the main character.
And the system ensures they always win, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I've got no choice but to wear red too!
All to stay the most entertaining and take the win!
"I don't quite get it, but it seems to make sense in her head."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, guess it's about time I head out
to find the next fishing spot~

Just as Gold Ship
was about to leave—
(DUN-DUN-DUUUUN!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, wait a second♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I thought I just heard "Protagonist = Red"...
Is that really true, though?

Suddenly, two Umamusume stood before Gold Ship
with overwhelming intensity!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Maruzen and Pearl?!
Why are you two suddenly here...?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, red is our color too, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's true the main character is often red,
but is that really all there is to red's charm?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think there's a thrilling,
stimulating, mature charm to it as well?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho-ho, there's also a villainous, dangerously be~au~ti~ful red.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wanna... take a taste
of this dangerous red flavor?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kh... What is with
this overwhelming villain aura...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I kept insisting that 'the protagonist is always red,'
and now I've lost all credibility!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainer, what should I do!?
choice_data_list: So there's more to red than meets the eye.
So there's more to red than meets the eye, you know.
I'm going to stay true to my beliefs!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainer, what should I do!?
choice_data_list: So there's more to red than meets the eye.
So there's more to red than meets the eye, you know.
I'm going to stay true to my beliefs!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I see... So the one underestimating
the power of red was me all along, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
From the very start, she had the potential
to become either the hero or the villain...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's rare coming from you, Golshi-chan.
You're actually going to quietly admit it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I admit it.
The time has come for me to grow up too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, climbing the stairs of adulthood, are we?
Then big sis here will show you the w-a-y♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, right—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...When you grow up, you see, you come
to understand all sorts of things—this, that, and everything in between."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't be scared, though. Everyone ends up like this.
There's nothing to fear. Come on, step up.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm heading out, Trainer...
I'm gonna go become an adult.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Everyone's gotta grow up eventually.
It just so happened that today was my day...
And then, the next day—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the sky sure is pretty.
I hope it's sunny tomorrow too... haha.
Gold Ship had a slightly vacant look in her eyes, more so than usual. Maybe she just took another step into adulthood...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Right... You're so right!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll use brute force to teach those guys
that my red is the true main character!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you want to go?
We're... pretty strong, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
If we're doing this, come at me with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
Here I go, the absolute stroooongest!!
Like a true protagonist, Gold Ship boldly stepped up to face the challenge—!!
However, ten minutes later—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I've still got plenty to spare♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I-It didn't do a thing to them...!
Those guys are way too strong...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still... I won't give up! Time for my ultimate technique!
World's Strongest BEEEEAAAAAMMMM!!

Gold Ship unleashed her ultimate secret technique!!
Or so it seemed—
(Eeeeeeeeeeek!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Gwah-buh-baah!!

"The secret technique hit Seeking the Pearl's sunglasses directly!
It bounced right back, and Gold Ship was sunk..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... Someday, I'll definitely prove
that I'm the main character... *cough*!

Gold Ship went down, her fierce fighting spirit still ablaze in her heart.
Her ambition... just might be rewarded someday.
